newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria, Yemen discuss "challenges" posed by Israel.
newsitem.headline: Syria, Yemen discuss "challenges" posed by Israel.

text.p: Syrian President Hafez al-Assad and Yemeni Prime Minister Abdul-Aziz Abdul-Ghani on Wednesday discussed how to rally Arab states to confront challenges posed by Israel's hardline government.

Assad's spokesman said Abdul-Ghani handed the Syrian leader a message from his Yemeni counterpart Ali Abdullah Saleh and that Assad gave him a responding letter during a meeting at the presidential palace in Damascus.

The spokesman gave no details but Syria, Yemen and Arab states have condemned Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for rejecting the principles on which the Arab-Israeli peace talks were based, especially the land-for-peace formula.

The Yemeni prime minister left Damascus later on Wednesday after a two-day visit during which Syria and Yemen signed nine cooperation agreements aimed at boosting bilateral cooperation in various fields, officials said.
